notes.title: SPEARHEAD: Breakthrough DevLog 09
notes.content:
[p]It’s still blazing hot outside... We really need some rain![/p][p]Unfortunately, this dev log doesn’t come with a video. :([/p][p]Some of the goals from the last update have been delayed, but we’ve managed to make progress on other areas instead. Let’s get into it.
[/p][h1]Completed Work
[/h1][list][*][p]4 New Head Arts

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/1443fa577f3c04165f945bf93a7a82a475737905.png"][/img]Delightful Morning · Nuclear War · The Darkness Within · When the Curtain Falls[/p][/*][*][p]Modular Wall System[/p][p]Placing walls piece by piece was causing optimization issues, so we introduced a new modular wall feature. No matter the placement direction, walls now connect seamlessly and are processed as one continuous structure.[/p][/*][*][p]New Shadow & Lighting System[/p][p]The old Unity 2D Light system didn’t quite fit the top-down shooter perspective, so we built a brand-new shadow system specifically for objects.[/p][p]Shadows now dynamically adapt to the player’s position, making environments feel more three-dimensional without obstructing gameplay.[/p][p]After months of trials, we split light into four categories:[/p][p][b]Light around the player[/b][/p][p][b]Light that blocks vision beyond walls[/b][/p][p][b]Light that defines objects[/b][/p][p]Diffused light that scatters through doors, windows, and open spaces[/p][p]These work together to make darkness meaningful, while shadows organically shift along with the light system. This was one of the longest tasks, right alongside the Overseer AI.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/bf61809aca29c216c94cc9293cdcf52cbe536794.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/44497a258216e3478234ea64bcde29406debfdd3.png"][/img]
[/p][/*][*][p]Importance of Darkness[/p][p]Shadows are now fully implemented, interacting with the light system to create tension and depth in every encounter.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/e06a3c9465b1c56d0f718d848eaf1f3e2a5dd110.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/9391acbb55d3012cdd3925b1f00222d7eec29aa0.png"][/img]
[/p][/*][*][p]New Special Enemy – Foamer[/p][p]A new type of enemy has been added: The Foamer, which sprays bubbles to obstruct and threaten players.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/d21b8f624fbeb8b7cd487faa016d9798bc24a7ae.png"][/img]
[/p][/*][/list][h1]Work in Progress
[/h1][list][*][p]Chapter 1, Act 1 Map[/p][p]Still under heavy development.[/p][/*][*][p]Overseer AI[/p][p]This has been the most time-consuming task of the past two months.[/p][p]The Overseer tracks player progress in real time and dynamically adjusts difficulty within the chosen difficulty range.[/p][p]It takes into account player health, pacing, number of enemies, and more to fine-tune pressure on the squad.[/p][p]Importantly, the Overseer never lowers difficulty below what the player selected. If you choose “Hard,” it won’t reduce it to “Easy.”[/p][p]The core system is complete, and we’re now preparing pressure and flexibility tests.[/p][/*][*][p]Lobby[/p][p]Foundations are in progress.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/381778f49c25a44ae711ef5397d224c9c8478b1a.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/e069dc7582a624624626c0765e55262b6f5d647f.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Enemy Placement System[/p][p]Our enemy spawning system for Spearhead: Breakthrough is inspired by several different games.[/p][p]There are three main types of “Walkers”:[/p][p][b]Wanderers – roam the map aimlessly[/b][/p][p][b]Aggressives – detect and chase players quickly[/b][/p][p][b]Horde Walkers – appear in groups during assaults[/b][/p][p]This system will continue to evolve over the coming months. It factors in player position, visibility, health, ammo, combat state, and game progress to spawn enemies dynamically. Every run will feel different, with encounters adapting organically.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Next Goals[/h1][p][/p][list][*][p]Stress system for the Overseer[/p][/*][*][p]Refined player movement speeds[/p][/*][*][p]Player code cleanup[/p][/*][*][p]Rework on debris when enemies are destroyed[/p][/*][*][p]Implement object destruction[/p][/*][*][p]Rework fragments, bullet holes, and smoke effects[/p][/*][*][p]Additional lobby features[/p][/*][/list][p]We originally aimed for a closed test by the end of the year, but with the extra workload, it’ll likely be pushed back. We’ll keep moving as quickly as we can—thanks for sticking with us to the end![/p][p][b]As always, questions are welcome.[/b][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/d2482638ace42c9e465cd219928a7413b5340b5b.png"][/img]
No! This is NOT fine! It's burning hot![/p]

notes.title: SPEARHEAD: Breakthrough DevLog 08
notes.content:
[p]How will this summer pass us by?[/p][p]Before it gets too hot, let’s dive into this devlog we prepared.
[/p][h1]Completed Work
[/h1][p][b]Gadgets[/b][/p][p]– We’ve fixed all the bugs with gadgets.[/p][p]They’re finally working perfectly!
[/p][p][b]First Boss of the Raid “The House of Light”[/b][/p][p]– This will be the first massive enemy you encounter.[/p][p]The bigger they are, the louder they fall.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/a6cb5c9ce6adaf74d7b54304854bbe89c9fe0ceb.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Special Enemies[/b][/p][p]– “Smoker,” which deploys smoke to block vision, and “Volt,” which uses a stun baton, are now complete.[/p][p]Smoker explodes with a cloud of smoke when defeated by hitting its exposed weak point on the belly.[/p][p]If you want to avoid the explosion, you’ll need to destroy its helmet first and hit the weak point on its head to take it down.[/p][p]For Volt, we designed it so that hitting the belly weak point would trigger an electric blast upon death, but since we’re not sure how this will affect game balance, we’ve temporarily disabled this feature for now.
[/p][p][b]Enemy Behavior and Animation Adjustments[/b][/p][p]– Fixed the issue where enemy hand positions were misaligned.[/p][p]Enemies now pause briefly after attacking before striking again.
[/p][p][b]Hit Effects Updated[/b][/p][p]– The hit effects that display when bullets hit enemies have been updated.

[b]Molotov, Wire Grenade, and Clock Bomb[/b][/p][p]– Molotovs ignite the ground.[/p][p]Wire grenades deploy slowing wire to hinder enemy movement.[/p][p]The Clock bomb rings loudly to attract nearby enemies—and then explodes.
[/p][previewyoutube="-dVt0ClKC6A;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h1]Work in Progress
[/h1][p][b]Weather[/b][/p][p]– We are working on weather effects.[/p][p]Visual effects are implemented, but weather-related debuffs for players are not yet complete.
[/p][p][b]Lobby[/b][/p][p]– This will be the lobby where all players can gather and spend time together.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/adb57727c01f63cfc5ecb4657587f44be41ce09f.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Act 1, Chapter 1 Map[/b][/p][p]– Only the basic structure has been created so far.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/6ca0f051894058ae340b32a73ebb4cff56f6e4a0.png"][/img][/p][h1]Next Goals
[/h1][p]– Implement weather debuff effects[/p][p]– Complete Act 1, Chapter 1 map[/p][p]– Add more special enemies[/p][p]– Add functional areas within the lobby (firing range, game selection)
[/p][p]There’s a unique satisfaction in letting work flow naturally and smoothly.[/p][p]So far, everything is going well without any major issues.
[/p][p][b]Questions are always welcome![/b]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/68fa55bb78f94337cd13c303f0de0ebbce97d075.png"][/img][/p][p]Sometimes, the most primitive methods work best.[/p]

notes.title: SPEARHEAD: Breakthrough DevLog 07
notes.content:
The season of lovely flowers has come… but they’ve withered far too soon.

Let’s move on to development updates.

[h1][Completed Work][/h1]

Head Art

- 4 new head art pieces have been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/5da36392339ae45684ee571b1af6a8f66299a56d.png[/img]

Standing Illustrations

- Character standing illustrations have been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/38f50d70e2aa8922e5fa5f1ee00a86efefbcbd08.png[/img]

Weapon Effects

- Shell casings are now ejected every time a gun is fired.

- A new hit effect plays when bullets strike enemies.

New Weapon Type

- A bow has been added. Drawing it fully will deal maximum damage to enemies.

- Impact grenades has been added.

New Weapon

- 1 assault rifle has been added.

Screen Effects

- Effects for down, injured, taking damage, and electrocution have been added.

- The screen now shakes when a grenade explodes nearby.

Explosion Marks

- Grenade explosions now leave scorch marks on the ground.

[h1][Work in Progress][/h1]

In-Game UI

- We're currently working on a UI layout that can display all four players on screen.

Gadgets

- Still plagued with bugs, unfortunately.
But don’t worry—this is an important system and it won't be scrapped.

Scopes

- Working on scoped view for sniper rifles and certain special weapon types.

Main Menu

- Prototyping a few designs.
We’ll share some visuals once we’ve made more progress.

[previewyoutube=Ufx6GfaR-_M;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][Next Goals][/h1]

- Add 3 special enemy types

- Complete implementation of gadgets

- Build the lobby

- Rework online functionality

- Add weather effects

A little ramble about Early Access:
As mentioned long ago, the game will be completely free to play until its official release.
Development is still in full swing, but we plan to add more head art, character outfits, and weapons.
If there’s a costume or unique weapon you'd like to see, feel free to let us know anytime!

There’s no meme in this devlog.
I’m just... too tired.

[b]Questions are always welcome![/b]

notes.title: SPEARHEAD: Breakthrough DevLog 06
notes.content:
As the cold fades away and the warm sun rises, it's time to move forward.

The foundation has been completed.
Let’s get to the main updates.

[h1]Completed Work[/h1]

Enemies
- Now move toward the player at a faster speed.
- If their legs are destroyed and they fall, they will continue chasing at a slower pace.
- Their heads now move up and down to keep their gaze on the player they are pursuing.
- A new alert state system has been added.
- When in an alert state, enemies will recognize and chase the player if they attack or get too close.

Melee Weapons
- The machete has been added.
- Melee weapons do not have durability and will not break.
- They can hit all enemies within their attack range.

Armor Plates
- Using an armor plate increases the player's armor by +1 (max 4).
- When the player takes explosive, bullet, or projectile damage, an equipped armor plate will be destroyed instead of losing health.
- Unequipped armor plates can be dropped on the ground so other players can pick them up.

Wall and Map Construction
- A system for placing walls, tiles, and game objects has been established, allowing for faster and more efficient map creation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/20f2e0d23b42d5bb7de2b52689423cda9f289b4b.png[/img]

Player Mechanics
- When a player’s health reaches 0, they enter a downed state.
- Downed players can be carried by other players.
- Downed players cannot move but can still attack enemies with a sidearm.
- After 60 seconds in a downed state, players enter a critical state where they are unable to perform any actions.
- Downed or critically wounded players can be revived by teammates using the interaction button.
- Reviving a critically wounded player takes longer than reviving a downed player.

Multiplayer
- Up to 4 players can now join a single session.
- Players are assigned a number (1, 2, 3, or 4) in the order they join. If a player leaves, the numbers will shift accordingly.
- If the host leaves the game, the leadership will be passed to the next player in line.
- Weapons dropped on the ground can be picked up and used by other players.

[previewyoutube=7nSy4eHeyn4;full][/previewyoutube]

'Broken Cage' Raid Poster

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/9a3c907a9e61a80210b3f5b13d0c69714870f370.png[/img]

[h1]Work in Progress[/h1]

New Special Enemies
- The ‘Breacher’ has been scrapped and will be replaced with new enemy types.
- Smoker – Creates vision-obscuring smoke.
- Twitch – Uses an electric stun baton to grab and damage players.
- Former – Sprays foam to immobilize players or block their path.
- More enemy types are currently in development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/391b585c27efaaaeeda4c1580922ab411531c422.png[/img]

[h1]Next Goals[/h1]

- Screen effects
- Environmental effects
- Loadout system
- New gadgets and weapons
- Additional weapon types

It took a long time to build the foundation—has it already been two years?
Now it’s time to speed things up and push development forward. Let’s pick up the pace!

[b]Questions are always welcome![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/d5e55f2241df237cb69d36092f694277f65360e6.png[/img]

Hold!

notes.title: SPEARHEAD: Breakthrough DevLog 05
notes.content:
The time has come to welcome a new year.
How was your year?

Some of the features we teased in the last log have been delayed.
However, we managed to complete even more features instead.

[h1]Completed Work[/h1]

- Grenade Explosion
We’ve replaced the old sprite effects with realistic smoke effects.

- Bullet Trajectory Rework
Fixed an issue where bullet trajectories resembled laser beams. Redesigned them for better realism.

- Muzzle Flash
Guns now emit smoke from the muzzle and the ejection port with every shot.

- Material-Specific Bullet Effects
Bullets now produce effects tailored to the materials they hit.

- Lighting Effects
Objects now cast shadows depending on the position of the light source—360 degrees of dynamic lighting!

- Multiple Player Connections
Although the lobby feature has been delayed, players can now connect to the same session simultaneously.

-Raid Poster
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/8b9869bf6f7365d38782682bb3793ca54dbda18e.png[/img]

[h1]Work in Progress[/h1]

- New Weapons: Shotgun and Assault Rifle
Adding sound effects will make these even better!

- Line-of-Sight System
Remember the feature that lets players see behind walls or objects if they’re positioned above them?
This time, we’re implementing a system that prevents players from spotting enemies hidden behind walls or objects.

- Destructible Enemy Body Parts
Enemies now have destructible body parts that react dynamically to damage.

- Two New Special Enemies

Siren: A camera-like enemy that detects movement.
Breacher: A ramming enemy that pushes other enemies aside to charge at the player and self-destruct.
Sprites for these enemies are complete, and coding is underway.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/58da51f0e849efa6fd892c4cf7d3ea3a2729d5f6.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/736312de0586cb7a0c189655182b6a2653a49494.gif[/img]

[previewyoutube=rPcf2DgPCtA;full][/previewyoutube]

They may seem a bit lackluster at this stage, but sound effects and screen shake will be added later as final touches.
Don’t worry—we won’t release them in their current state!

[h1]Canceled Work[/h1]

- Enemy Death Animations
Unfortunately, this feature had to be canceled due to technical limitations.
Instead, we’ll expand on the destructible body part system.

[h1]Next Goals[/h1]

- Finalize all functions for normal enemies (attack, death).
- Finalize all functions for the player.
- Add more special enemies.
- Implement interactions between the player and enemies.
- Add more weapons.

[h1]Goals for 2025[/h1]

- Complete two chapters and one raid.
- Add eight regular weapons and three legacy weapons.
- Add four special enemies.
- Implement the lobby feature.
[b]- Conduct Spearhead Breakthrough closed testing & recruit participants (tentatively planned for Q4, barring major issues).[/b]

Questions are always welcome.
[b]See you next year, and Happy New Year![/b] 🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/d5b10cd58b5b097955d7c0725e129cf663611beb.png[/img]

The cake is real! not a lie!

notes.title: SPEARHEAD: Breakthrough DevLog 04
notes.content:
A season of weight and knowledge: Fall.
Our game could use some "weight" of its own, too…

[h1][Completed Work][/h1]

- Enemy Sprite Rework
Reworked to reduce in-game issues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/e5efc915517a98ad0c40f36d7bca0241d977c501.png[/img]

- Map Tile Set Rework
Reworked for similar reasons as above.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/1cd526e1013fb920d2bdbb12c7fc79403074efa5.png[/img]

- Wall Transparency Vision Feature
Developed a new feature to address objects or enemies being obscured by walls. When the player is positioned above a wall, the wall becomes semi-transparent.

[h1][Ongoing Work][/h1]

- Lighting Effects and Bullet Impacts by Material
Showcased parts of this last month. Although expected to finish this month, additional time is required due to adding different bullet fragment effects depending on bullet size.

- Enemy Destruction Animations
Working on animations for total disarmament of enemies, from disintegrating pieces to more realistic options like enemies collapsing mid-stride or losing balance after losing their head.

- Raid Map Sprites

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/81d4b33770c326e75106aa10b55fe8f27c76a0a6.png[/img]

- In-Game Concept Art
Created two concept art pieces to help outline the development direction and assist your understanding. More concept art will be showcased.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/2dfff715dfad8343217a8fba4a1faa4ec431ae6b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/76499add61f3cdba416286825b54d8b478bbc4cf.png[/img]

- Enemy AI
Improved AI from the previous version. Enemies now search paths faster and chase players more relentlessly than before.

[previewyoutube=tkWFDVGYQBM;full][/previewyoutube]

- Crosshairs
Still in progress. Currently causing some bugs, so we’ll share it once stable alongside other features.

- New UI Design
Redesigned to align with the game concept. Parts of the game UI are completed, with more concept art to be shown soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/5b4af8ab8032d7a722b7899ccd4d3b33445158d0.png[/img]

[h1][Next Objectives][/h1]

- Simultaneous connections in the same session across multiple players
- Adding lobby functionality
- Special enemies
- Implementing grenade explosions
- Backend work
- Enemy Body Part Destruction Feature

Questions are always welcome.
[b]See you next time![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/c6949de1a4df8c244f86ad5a09a87900c937a895.png[/img]

Just J...

notes.title: SPEARHEAD: Breakthrough DevLog 03
notes.content:
We’ve survived the heat this year as well. Let’s get straight to the point.

[h1][Completed Work][/h1]

- Autumn Map Sprites

- Three Types of Regular Enemy Sprites 
We've created new, larger, and more visible sprites compared to the enemies from the previous game, "Spearhead."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/ec9c7f505373b330db378c5018276cfd35010b11.png[/img]

- Object Throwing 
Objects now follow the correct trajectory when thrown.

- Object Fragmentation 
When the player shoots small objects, they break into fragments and are destroyed. If an object is between the player and the crosshair when shooting, that object will also be destroyed.

[h1][Ongoing Work][/h1]

- Test Room 
The test room will continue to evolve and expand as development progresses.

- Different Bullet Fragments and Smoke for Each Material 
Work is still ongoing for objects made of steel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/46e1613dcfb69dc4c15f4fbfbbbb724c90a56371.png[/img]

- Weapon Animation Overhaul 
There’s an issue where weapon animations break due to incorrect sequencing during development. We are currently revising all animations to fix this problem.

- Four New Characters 
To balance the gender ratio, we’re working on four male characters. The designs may change as development continues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/bfa668c4187b2e030fa11e09d53264f102368d80.png[/img]

- Wall Collision Detection 
This is the most challenging task. We've been working for a long time to ensure that players, bullets, grenades, objects, and more don’t get obstructed by walls and pillars during gameplay.

One more thing to mention: If the upcoming feature that allows players to see beyond walls doesn’t fit well with the gameplay or negatively impacts it, we’ll remove it. Instead, we plan to make impassable walls behind pillars and adjust the paths so characters don’t overlap.

[previewyoutube=MWt3AFbLxS8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][Canceled Work][/h1]

- Weapon Throwing 
After five months of development, we decided to cancel the weapon throwing feature due to numerous bugs that delayed progress.

The weapon throwing feature was identical to the object throwing feature. In place of this feature, we’ll include more throwable objects in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/5bf90216c0d30f4cfb308f5df500d7b4ee60f5fd.png[/img]

[h1][Next Goals][/h1]

- Enemy AI
- Lighting Effects
- Vision Feature to See Players Behind Walls
- Raid Map Sprites
- UI Design
- Crosshair

[b]Questions are always welcome. See you next time![/b]

notes.title: SPEARHEAD: Breakthrough DevLog 02
notes.content:
Welcome to our summer development log.
It's scorching hot!

[h1]1. Consumables and Grenade Animations[/h1]
We are working on the animations for using consumables and grenades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/68f132dc8ced63026fcaaf8ac624224a042ebd31.png[/img]

[h1]2. Objects Throwing[/h1]
Players can now pick up and throw objects.
Last time, due to numerous issues, we couldn't show this directly, but many of those issues have been resolved.
There are still problems with enemies being pushed back when hit by objects, which we are currently fixing.

[h1]3. Grenade Collision System Overhaul[/h1]
This was the most time-consuming task in this development log.
We added a system where grenades collide with objects and fall to the ground.
No more grenades flying through walls and ceilings.

[previewyoutube=vZPBvBhf7os;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]4. Enemy Sprite Rework[/h1]
The appearance of enemies is being changed.
They will be bigger and more clearly visible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/b9d5af9cb084e67407fccf64765aaf2f4cd2878b.png[/img]

[h1]5. Weapon Slot System[/h1]
We've implemented a system where weapons can be assigned to the 1 and 2 keys, and consumables or grenades to the 3 and 4 keys.
You can choose to forego consumables and carry only grenades, or carry two of the same gun.

[previewyoutube=fIwmNDr51M4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]6 Completion of Shooting System[/h1]
The shooting system is now completely finished.
We've adjusted the positioning of the guns and characters more precisely, and fixed some bugs that occurred during gun operation.

[h1]7. Autumn Map[/h1]
Map development has officially started.
It will take a long time to complete, but we are working on maps with various concepts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/bce167e95e75c4311b41991a4235d70de043fccb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/f57b6d764909ebbd0591f77af6f081aee6e83dde.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/0e9aba9f9023975ec3b2615752c63a3ff66ccc14.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/adb28a80774fe025d301b9e3b06911c999ded392.png[/img]

We are progressing slowly but surely.
As always, questions are welcome.

The heatwave has started.
Take care, and the next development log will be uploaded in August.

A preview of the next development log...

-Four new characters
-fragment effects
-Various gun effects
-Test room
-And probably more

[b]Goodbye for now![/b]

notes.title: Spearhead: Breakthrough DevLog 01
notes.content:
It’s been a while!

It's a little late, but we've accomplished a lot.
Let’s get straight to the point.

[h1]1. Movement animation[/h1]

The walking and running animation has been completed.
Character Movement Animation
Animations for reviving other characters and manipulating objects are still being worked on.

One piece of good news is that we've rewritten the character movement code to reduce the amount of code that was too long.
Fixed an issue where the character would be bounced at high speed if caught by an object while moving.

[previewyoutube=h3R1dfQbgTg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]2. New Firearm Code, New Animations[/h1]

Now you can drop your firearm or pick it up.
You can do more while on the move.

[previewyoutube=WKZi50buO00;full][/previewyoutube]

And we're introducing new gun animations.
I hope you like it.

[previewyoutube=uFy9N5HwaXU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]3. Changed Shooting System[/h1]

This is one of the biggest changes in ‘Spearhead: Breakthrough’.
The reason the development log was delayed was because we were testing various shooting functions.
In the previous, 'Spearhead', bullets flew endlessly in the direction the aiming point was pointed.
In this 'Breakthrough', bullet hits randomly within an invisible circular area within the aiming point.
As you continue to fire a gun, the crosshairs expands and the bullet's hitting range becomes wider.
If you fire the gun in bursts or shoot while walking, the crosshairs expand to be smaller.
We chose this approach because it allows players to more clearly specify which enemies to shoot at.

If the player is able to shoot, a red dot will be displayed between the crosshairs.
If the red dot is off, it means something is blocking it.

[previewyoutube=Iy2pu6niWW4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]4. More objects[/h1]

We are still working on a lot of objects.
When damaged by explosives or numerous bullets, the object's appearance changes.
Actually, all that changes is the appearance. There are no other functions. :)

Objects containing supplies have a special marking.
This object can be destroyed.
Destroying objects will drop items that the player lacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/047bb1f3f8723bfaf89016b068c4d58069e6330a.png[/img]

[h1]5. Throwing an object[/h1]

Players can pick up and throw some objects.

Indestructible Objects - Players cannot pass through them. Bullets cannot pass through

Miscellaneous Objects - Objects that break when hit by a bullet or a player passes by.

notes.title: SPEARHEAD : Breakthrough
notes.content:
There is no longer support for Spearhead
I didn't get any result.

Instead, i`ll begin developing other project.
Sorry to have kept you waiting for a long time.

Let me tell you about the project.

[h1][b]SPEARHEAD : Breakthrough (working title)[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/f201f8c72adbadb59ab57f3b86f335eecf77c07b.png[/img]

I was planning a completely new project. Unrelated to Spearhead.
However, it was a shame to end Spearhead like this.
So, I decided to change my plan.

Do you remember our survey? There have been many requests for additional content.
CO-OP, Loadout, Raid, Perk...etc
I`ll implement all of these.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/97eedd1769dd4098042d7a5ec7955f0b79a33b68.png[/img]

Spearhead: Breakthrough is an online co-op game project.
It only consists of characters from the arcade mode.
You choose to play as one of four characters. The goal of the game is to reach the safe area.
There are 4 Acts in total, and each Act consists of 5 Scenes and 1 Raid.
Each Scene takes 10-20 minutes to complete.
Raids will take longer than this, of course.

I will actively use the features of 'Home Alone' and 'Lord of guns'.
Various weapons and loadout, weather and hunger, food and crafting
And one more thing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/4831a04d6bcb640e8357360bc51fbf10e80e0853.png[/img]

OZ, J, RHYS, MITCH
Each character has a unique Perk.
Before starting the game, you can customize your loadout and choose 2 of 6 Perks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/cdc1c60a9e2e347f6869cd87a5954d95ca10b642.png[/img]

2 Perks. 2 weapons. 1 consumable. 1 throwables
Weapons can be equipped with any type of weapon.
You can even carry two assault rifles. Or, you can carry just two melee weapons.
And there's a special weapon, the 'Legacy' type weapon. it`s from 'Lord of guns'
The 'Legacy' have special abilities.
Let's see. I'll show you two 'Legacy'

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/e4b9c7a3e3b0865c6880f07796c4d46534ee67a4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/281931ff9b73d7fef7ed8e4e4db0f6b7368d69ec.png[/img]

Legacy weapons can only be obtained from certain scenes or complete challenges.
Legacy weapons can only have one equipped in loadout.

When the content is partially completed, we will release it as Early Access.

[b]- 2 Act, 10 Scene, 2 Raids
- 15 Legacy weapons
- Implement all character Perks.
- Implement multiplayer and companion AI[/b]

In the future, information on how development is going will be posted as announcements. with Bulletcow youtube channel
When all the above features are implemented, it will be released with Early Access information.

[h1][b]Play for free while developing. Develop together[/b][/h1]

As promised, everyone can play for free during Early Access.
Anyone can enjoy the game without restrictions until the official release.
No pay, Just play

I made a promise to you, so I'm releasing it for free.
The important thing is, i want to hear from you while development is underway.
Translation, contents, balance, internet connection, and more
This game needs your help.

I`ll develop this project together with you.
As always, please let us know of any improvements
All of your comments are valuable.
Weapons you want to see, new Raid, the name of the game
Please feel free to talk

notes.title: SERIOUS MATTER
notes.content:
[h1][b]This is a serious situation.[/b][/h1]

While transferring data, the hard drive crashed and all data files were corrupted.
I focused on recovery work for two weeks, but there was no significant result.
Development data, as well as backup files and existing data are all damaged, so other measures are needed.

Fortunately, I have in-game sprites, CGs, and update files from previous versions on another drive.
I plan to use these to continue development.

As a gamer like you, I think you must have been very disappointed with this news.
This accident is all my fault.

i`m really sorry to disappoint you again.

But, I haven't given up yet.
After the accident, I even thought about giving up the game and development.
I decided not to give up to keep my promise to you.
Just one more time, please trust me

There are three options.

[h1][1. Complete recovery of development environment succeeded][/h1]

So far, after two weeks of hard work, I've succeeded in separating the code and assets from the existing files.
How to disassemble the rest of the files is still under research.

If all files are successfully disassembled, i can rebuild the development environment within 2-3 months and continue updating again.

[h1][2. Update using mod][/h1]

If the first method fails, there is a way to create a mod and overwrite the game files.

The method using mods is very difficult to modify the details of the game.
But, There will be no problem with updating the content regularly.

Mod development is a field I am completely unfamiliar with, so I am researching it.

[h1][3. If this happens... it's all over.][/h1]

It's the worst case, when all means and methods don't work.
I don't want to think about this...

In this case, I would give up Spearhead and start developing other projects right away.
I cannot betray those who believed in and waited for Spearhead.
As promised, i will provide wallpapers and paper models periodically.
Also, you are free to use all the code and sprite data contained within the game files.
You may modify the code and sprites, use them commercially.
It's all yours.

Except for the songs and sound effects. that's not mine

Other projects will be open to you free of charge during development.
When development is complete, the game will be changed to a paid game.
The game will be provided for free to applicants who purchase the Spearhead Paper Pack.
because it's my mistake. I have to take responsibility.

If i choose the third method, i will tell you about the project.
I don't want to choose this method.

[h1][b][You may be wondering][/b][/h1]

■ Can't you develop a new one?

The whole development environment is gone, so I don't know how many years it will take to develop a new one...
The current situation is depressing me... It's only my fault.

■ Can't just release the arcade mode as a separate game?

In addition to the problems mentioned above, there is one more problem.
In Korea, in order to sell a game, it must be reviewed by a game management institution.
It can be uploaded to Steam only after the review is completed by the management institution.
The biggest problem is that the cost of applying for a review is very expensive.
If i release it as a completely free game without earning any revenue, can skip the review.
However, Spearhead's arcade mode is already related to the main game, so it seems that it will not be able to avoid review.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If any of you know how to make game mods using the Unity engine, 
or know how to completely disassemble the game files, please help me.
Feel free to contact us through the Steam forum or Bullet Cow mail.

I will keep you informed as development progresses.
To prevent this kind of accident from happening again, I will keep the backup data on multiple hard drives.

[h1]Once again, I'm really sorry.[/h1]

notes.title: Important notices & update delayed
notes.content:
[b]Hello. Commander![/b]

I would like to inform you of important information prior to the update.
Please read to the end!

[h1][b]Update delayed[/b][/h1]

During the month of December, a series of unfortunate incidents occurred.

The computer I was using for development is broken.
Fortunately, a friend donated his computer to me. It's a bit old, but better than nothing.
It seems like it will take a long time to move the data to another computer.
The boiler in the house is out of order. There was an uproar.
My eyes are getting weird. I'm going back and forth to the hospital for an overhaul.
<Home Alone> is almost done, but it still has a critical bug
And I've been infected with Corona again...

What a horrible life...

For this reason, i have to postpone the update to January.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/214abc85e9fd46cfec1a00bd1c94793a392224b4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/2a2ab7f65ea9ab3eb16a247f36d4b49bc9842671.png[/img]

I'm really sorry.
I ask for your understanding.

For those of you who are disappointed, I would like to inform you of some Q&A and future plans.
And some extra rewards.

[h1][b]So what's the plan?[/b][/h1]

[u][b]1. The description of the game in the steam store will be changed.[/b][/u]

I will change the game description to be more intuitive. more detail.

New images will be added, and some images already uploaded will be changed.
Arcade mode and main story descriptions will be added.

[u][b]2. Spearhead's timeline is now split into two.[/b][/u]

The 'Main Timeline' is a world in where classified organization have been successfully created and remain stable.
The 'Arcade Timeline' is a world where classified organization never existed and humanity's efforts have failed.

There is absolutely no connection between the two timelines.

The stories in 'Main Timeline' are very serious.
The background of 'Arcade Timeline' is dark, but the story will be bright.

In both timelines, stories worthy of the game's title will be added.

[u][b]3. Support for Spearhead will continue until 2024.[/b][/u]

I will support until 2024 to provide more experiences to users who enjoy Spearhead.
At the same time, i plan to develop other projects in parallel with the update.
Support for Spearhead may not end even in 2024. may be extended.

By the way, what is the difference between 'until' and 'through'? English is still difficult.

[u][b]4. From January next year, i will give you a wallpaper every month.[/b][/u]

Wallpapers featuring the characters of Spearhead are given every month.
The address where you can get the wallpaper will be posted along with the news, so always check it out!
If there is a theme you want, please let me know.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/dabe0740e36fcef1f2653f2be5e9659d8a2d4f43.png[/img]

[u][b]5. The story of the 'Main Timeline' isn't over yet.[/b][/u]

Spearhead's backstory and story don't quite fit the Bullet Hell style.
It's a very dark, somber, serious atmosphere. (Not an arcade)
However, i will try to present as many stories as possible with different techniques and in a suitable way.

[h1][b]Q&A[/b][/h1]

[b]○ Loadout, weapon customization, additional weapons...etc[/b]

This feature will be implemented in Arcade Raid mode.
In the 'main timeline', it will be implemented in some missions to be added later.

[b]○ Anything other than defense?[/b]

I`m planning various modes to provide a more diverse experience.
Sniper missions in embassies, VIP escorts in quarantine zones, counter-terrorism operations in large hospitals
I`m planning missions that require tactical movement.

[b]○ Are there any characters from other countries?[/b]

Of course there is.

Mexico's 'Fantasma', France's 'Weaver', Indonesia's 'Bentik', USA's 'Catcher', etc...
If possible, I would like to add agents from multiple countries to the story without overlapping.

[b]○ Multiplayer! cooperation![/b]

The most requested
To start with the conclusion, it is difficult to implement with the 'Spearhead' build.
That doesn't mean it's impossible. I mean it's difficult.
It wasn't built with multiplayer in mind, so even if i start developing right now, 
i can't guarantee how long it will take.
I`ll consider this request once the game enters the stabilization phase.

[h1][b]And...?[/b][/h1]

After the next update, the roadmap will change.
To be precise, the roadmap until the last quarter of 2023 will be determined.
There are no changes to the roadmap already posted.

A paper model will be added.
One enemy, one arcade character
It will be distributed together with the free paper model DLC.
Free!

In the meantime, the reason why there was no notice in Japanese is because the friend who was in charge of the Japanese translation got a job.
So, I am only asking my friend to translate in-game.

I ask for the understanding from Japanese users.

[h1][b]Regards[/b][/h1]

I'm really sorry to bring you unfortunate news.
I`ll try to update it as soon as possible.

Always take care of yourself and hope to see you in the next update.
I should be a bit careful too.

[h1][i]And happy new year for you![/i][/h1]

notes.title: Teaser&Notice
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello. Commander![/b][/h1]
I was going to update sooner, but it was late because I was infected with Corona.
...It`s really hurt
Anyway, let's get straight to the point.

Arcade mode <Dog Fight> is ready!
The update date is as follows.
September 25th 3:00 AM(PST)/ September 26th 8:00 PM(KST)

[previewyoutube=W5YG_XZKduc;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][h1][b]About <DOG FIGHT>[/b][/h1][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/01f5470825277069631787a1292fc8c4eff3da11.png[/img]

A strange figure with animal ears and a tail wakes up from a long slumber.
She doesn't have any memories.
Will she be able to get out of this place by defeating the constantly influx of robots?

[h1][u][b]How to play[/b][/u][/h1]

<Dog Fight> Arcade mode allows players to choose an effect before each wave starts.
Positive effects are determined randomly and negative effects can be chosen by the player.
After completing the 8th wave, two bosses will appear.
Defeat the boss and win the game!

[u][h1][b]Two bosses[/b][/h1][/u]

Two bosses will appear when you complete the final 8th wave.
The boss will constantly annoy the player with his unique weapon.
Defeat the boss and win the game!

[h1][u][b]Is that all...?[/b][/u][/h1]

For one month, i plan to perform convenience and balance patches.
Please feel free to tell me in the discussion what you are uncomfortable with or wish to improve.

I'll be working on the next arcade mod as soon as the month-long patch is over.
I`m planning more things for you.

[b]Always take care of yourself, See you on the update day![/b]

notes.title: SPEARHEAD 1.01 updated + Arcade mod info
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Commander![/b]
It's been a long time since Spearhead was released.
Today's news is the update i promised you. It was also written on the roadmap.
And also brought some information about the arcade mode!

[h1][b]What's changed?[/b][/h1]

- The Unity engine has been updated.
In the process, 200 lines of obsolete code were deleted & corrected.
[u]*Engine updates can cause unexpected bugs. [/u]

- The engine update has changed the way and speed of the AI's movement.
It's not very felt.

- Fixed an issue with overlapping lines in the Primer(Alice) stage.

- In some cases, the STORY, OPTION, and EXIT buttons overlapped in the title screen.
I increased the spacing between the top and bottom of the button.

-  Added patch notes to the title screen.
Click to display the latest patch history.
The in-game patch notes will be more concise than the game news we see on Steam.

- The square box at the start of the game and intro skip have also been modified to be selectable areas.

[h1][b]What's next?[/b][/h1]

The next update goal is in June.

- I thought that hiding the additional objective would give players a lot of fun looking for it.
This was a miscalculation.
In the next update, we'll display a notification in-game to inform you of additional objective.

- Shows the number of wave in-game and the number of wave remaining.

- Added more resolution with 16:9 aspect ratio

- Added Steam Achievements
This will probably take longer.

[h1][b]Is there anything more?[/b][/h1]

I know that the game is short and there is not much more to enjoy.
So, I'm working on an arcade mode where the gameplay is the same, but you can enjoy it in a different way.

In Arcade Mode <Dog Fight>, you will receive a random effect for every attack.
No one knows if it will be positive or negative.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/55e6c2994eb745cf040fe9d93992fbc5efc0ec1b.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/25f36a5dcd60c0f00c43d468b0291ca738b5c7b6.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326963/56b73a90f9fd4e842617dab384b02f425f8cae79.png[/img]


[h1][b]Can I make a translation, language patch?[/b][/h1]

A few times, I have been asked about language patches.
yes, that's okay.
Actually, it's my job, but I don't have the money to entrust the translation.

[h1][u][b]to finish[/b][/u][/h1]

We are all going through the most difficult times.
Let's not lose hope, hope for a brighter tomorrow and pray for each other.

Always take care of yourself, and we hope to see you again in the next update.
